Gameplay.Components.HotChamber.name: HOT CHAMBER
Gameplay.Components.HotChamber.desc: Increases base Shell Damage by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease} when firing within 2 seconds of a completed reload

Gameplay.Components.SenseOverdrive.name: SENSE OVERDRIVE
Gameplay.Components.SenseOverdrive.desc: Increases Max Speed and Max Reverse Speed by {LevelValue} kph while you are spotted

Gameplay.Components.WeaknessAnalyzer.name: WEAKNESS ANALYZER
Gameplay.Components.WeaknessAnalyzer.desc: Damaging an enemy module speeds up your active reload by {LevelValue} seconds.
Gameplay.Components.WeaknessAnalyzer.note: This effect has a 6 second cooldown between activations

Gameplay.Components.AdaptiveHardening.name: ADAPTIVE HARDENING
Gameplay.Components.AdaptiveHardening.desc: Reduces Damage Taken by {LevelValuePercent} each second you are spotted. Maxes out at 12% and resets on going unspotted.

Gameplay.Components.CoreAmp.name: CORE AMP
Gameplay.Components.CoreAmp.desc: Using your ability empowers your next shot to generate {LevelValue} Energy if it penetrates

Gameplay.Components.ReactiveModules.name: REACTIVE MODULES
Gameplay.Components.ReactiveModules.desc: Reduces Damage Taken by {LevelValuePercent} when one of your modules is broken. The damage reduction is lost on firing.

Gameplay.Components.SensitiveSights.name: SENSITIVE SIGHTS
Gameplay.Components.SensitiveSights.desc: Increases Aim Speed and reduces Reload Time by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease} while you are unspotted
Gameplay.Components.SensitiveSights.note: Aim Speed is how quickly your aim reticle shrinks in size and becomes accurate.

Gameplay.Components.Duplicator.name: DUPLICATOR
Gameplay.Components.Duplicator.desc: Increases base Shell Damage by <bold>5</> and <bold>Doubles</> the number of shells gained from all sources

Gameplay.Components.QuickSlot.name: QUICK SLOT
Gameplay.Components.QuickSlot.desc: Firing alternate shells (secondary and tertiary shells) reduces Reload Time by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyDecrease}

Gameplay.Components.RelentlessAdapter.name: RELENTLESS ADAPTER
Gameplay.Components.RelentlessAdapter.desc: Increases Max Health by {LevelValue} and heals for the same amount when an enemy successfully damages one of your modules.
Gameplay.Components.RelentlessAdapter.note: Tracks are an example of a module

Gameplay.Components.Synchronizer.name: SYNCHRONIZER
Gameplay.Components.Synchronizer.desc: Increases Starting Energy by <bold>7.5</> and amplifies the Energy gained from spotting, tracking and bounce assists by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease}
Gameplay.Components.Synchronizer.note: Spotting, Tracking, and Bounce Assists generate 3% of the assist value as energy by default.

Gameplay.Components.ShiftCloak.name: SHIFT CLOAK
Gameplay.Components.ShiftCloak.note: Camouflage makes enemies need to be closer to spot you.

Gameplay.Components.PowerConverter.name: POWER CONVERTER
Gameplay.Components.PowerConverter.desc: Activating your ability heals you for every point of Energy it consumes and your Ability Cooldown is reduced by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyDecrease}

Gameplay.Components.Agitator.name: CALIBRATION AGITATOR
Gameplay.Components.Agitator.desc: Increases your Aim Speed and lowers your Base Dispersion by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease}. Bouncing a shot or having your shot bounced will triple this value until your next penetration.
Gameplay.Components.Agitator.note: Base Aiming Dispersion is how inaccurate your shot is while stationary and fully aimed.

Gameplay.Components.CoreBooster.name: CORE BOOSTER
Gameplay.Components.CoreBooster.desc: Increases every instance of Energy gain by {LevelValue}

Gameplay.Components.ModuleSurger.name: MOBILITY SURGER
Gameplay.Components.ModuleSurger.desc: Increases Max Health by {LevelValue}. Instantly repairs track and engine modules on ability use

Gameplay.Components.ShellStabilizer.name: SHELL STABILIZER
Gameplay.Components.ShellStabilizer.desc: Increases base Shell Damage By {LevelValue} while you're stationary

Gameplay.Components.MomentumImparter.name: MOMENTUM IMPARTER
Gameplay.Components.MomentumImparter.desc: Increases base Shell Damage by {LevelValue} while traveling over 40 kph

Gameplay.Components.ShellCharger.name: SHELL CHARGER
Gameplay.Components.ShellCharger.desc: Increases base Shell Damage by {LevelValue} whenever you penetrate an enemy. This effect can stack up to 3 times but falls off on a non-penetration.

Gameplay.Components.StableRangefinder.name: STABLE RANGEFINDER
Gameplay.Components.StableRangefinder.desc: Time to enter precision aiming is reduced by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyDecrease} when more than 8 seconds have elapsed since your last reload
Gameplay.Components.StableRangefinder.note: Precision Aiming can be activated by holding your aim reticle still for some time after it has fully aimed and it is no longer shrinking.

Gameplay.Components.ExtendedGearing.name: EXTENDED GEARING
Gameplay.Components.ExtendedGearing.desc: Increases Max Speed by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease} after actively throttling for more than 10 continuous seconds

Gameplay.Components.VulnBreaker.name: VULN BREAKER
Gameplay.Components.VulnBreaker.desc: Increases damage against modules by {LevelValuePercent}. Effect increases by <bold>2.5%</> each time you damage an enemy module.

Gameplay.Components.FrictionCapacitor.name: FRICTION CAPACITOR
Gameplay.Components.FrictionCapacitor.desc: Increases Max Speed by {LevelValue} kph. Effect briefly quintuples on landing after being airborne.

Gameplay.Components.SignatureObscurer.name: SIGNATURE OBSCURER
Gameplay.Components.SignatureObscurer.desc: Reduces time spotted by {LevelValueAbs} seconds and Speeds up your active reload by {LevelValueAbs} seconds when you become unspotted
Gameplay.Components.SignatureObscurer.note: An active reload is when your reload is currently counting down.

Gameplay.Components.PropagationDrive.name: PROPAGATION DRIVE
Gameplay.Components.PropagationDrive.desc: Increases base Shell Damage by <bold>2</> and Max Health by {LevelValue} on ability use
Gameplay.Components.PropagationDrive.note: This effect also heals you for the same amount it increases your Max Health by

Gameplay.Components.CatalyticReservoir.name: CATALYTIC RESERVOIR
Gameplay.Components.CatalyticReservoir.desc: Generates {LevelValue} energy when you land a penetration while having above <bold>50</> Energy

Gameplay.Components.DriftSparker.name: DRIFT SPARKER
Gameplay.Components.DriftSparker.desc: Increases your Max Speed by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease} with greatly increased acceleration for 3 seconds after Powersliding or Hoverdrifting.
Gameplay.Components.DriftSparker.note: Powersliding is when you slide while holding the handbrake. Hoverdrifting is the equivalent for hover vehicles but they do not lose momentum when doing so.

Gameplay.Components.SidescrapeGear.name: SIDESCRAPE GEAR
Gameplay.Components.SidescrapeGear.desc: Increases Hull Rotation Speed by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease} while not throttling.
Gameplay.Components.SidescrapeGear.note: Hull Rotation Speed is how fast you can rotate your vehicle's hull

Gameplay.Components.EnergyVent.name: ENERGY VENT
Gameplay.Components.EnergyVent.desc: Using your last energy charge increases Max Speed, Max Reverse Speed and Hull Rotation Speed by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease}. This effect can stack up to 5 times.
Gameplay.Components.EnergyVent.note: Your last energy charge is when you only have enough energy to use your ability once

Gameplay.Components.HullBellows.name: HULL BELLOWS
Gameplay.Components.HullBellows.desc: Your next ram after bouncing or being hit by a shot heals you for {LevelValue}.

Gameplay.Components.RedirectorGear.name: REDIRECTOR GEAR
Gameplay.Components.RedirectorGear.desc: Increases Hull Rotation Speed by {LevelValuePercentMultiplyIncrease}. Effect doubles while you are reloading.
Gameplay.Components.RedirectorGear.note: Hull Rotation Speed is how fast you can rotate your vehicle's hull

Gameplay.Components.OverflowShunt.name: OVERFLOW SHUNT
Gameplay.Components.OverflowShunt.desc: Increases your damage by {LevelValuePercent} per 10 Energy you're holding

Gameplay.Components.CascadeGate.name: CASCADE GATE
Gameplay.Components.CascadeGate.desc: Using an ability while above 50 Energy increases your Energy generation from all sources by {LevelValuePercent} for 15 seconds

Gameplay.Components.Densifier.name: DENSIFIER
Gameplay.Components.Densifier.desc: Bouncing an enemy shot increases your Max Health by {LevelValue} and heals for the same amount. Getting hit by a shot activates for half effect.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.HighAccuracy.Name: High Accuracy
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.HighAccuracy.Description: A shell with greatly improved accuracy and travel speed.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.HighExplosive.Name: High Explosive
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.HighExplosive.Description: Deals 20% more damage but has fixed 45mm penetration.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Silenced.Name: Silenced
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Silenced.Description: Fires silently without increasing visibility, but deals less damage.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.AbilityResource.Name: Energy
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.AbilityResource.Description: Grants 7 extra energy on successful penetrations.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Gargantuan.Name: Gargantuan
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Gargantuan.Description: A massive shell that deals 20% increased damage but has terrible accuracy.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Spotting.Name: Spotting
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Spotting.Description: Spots enemies on hit and also senses enemies near the impact but deals less damage and travels slower.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Momentum.Name: Momentum
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Momentum.Description: A slow moving shell that deals 30% increased damage after traveling 200 meters (half max vision range). Travels at a fixed 500 m/s.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Mobility.Name: Lightweight
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Mobility.Description: A high velocity light shell with lower penetration and damage but increases max forward and reverse speeds by 10% while loaded.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Crippling.Name: Crippling
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Crippling.Description: [IMPLEMENTATION NOT RELIABLE] Increases the target's repair time by 50% when it breaks a module

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Leech.Name: Siphon
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Leech.Description: Penetrating an enemy heals you for 15. This effect is tripled when you are below half health.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Unstable.Name: Unstable
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Unstable.Description: An unstable shell that increases Accuracy and Shell damage by 10% but restricts Max Speed while loaded.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.HighPen.Name: High Penetration
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.HighPen.Description: High pen shells granted from the center buff zone.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Smoke.Name: Blackout
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Smoke.Description: Bursts into a temporary blackout cloud on impact, blocking sight as a bush. Higher damage shells cause the cloud to last longer. Cannot pen.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.ChainLightning.Name: Tesla
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.ChainLightning.Description: On penetration, arcs lightning to up to 2 nearby enemies, dealing damage directly to them. Each jump reduces damage by 25%. Can also jump to (but not from) deployables.

Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Shotgun.Name: Bang Shells
Gameplay.Ammunition.Type.Shotgun.Description: Increased accuracy and velocity, but instantly spots the shooter regardless of position when fired.
